passages.text: Now Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming toward him with four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two maidservants.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the son of Isaac and Rebekah.
Jacob looked up.
He saw Esau coming toward him.
Esau was Jacob’s brother.
Esau had four hundred men with him.
Jacob divided the children.
He put some children with Leah.
He put some children with Rachel.
He put some children with the two maidservants.
passages.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א יַעֲקֹ֜ב עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה עֵשָׂ֣ו בָּ֔א וְעִמּ֕וֹ אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אִ֑ישׁ וַיַּ֣חַץ אֶת־ הַיְלָדִ֗ים עַל־ לֵאָה֙ וְעַל־ רָחֵ֔ל וְעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י הַשְּׁפָחֽוֹת׃

passages.text: He put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the father of the children.
Jacob had two wives, Leah and Rachel.
Jacob also had two maidservants.
Each woman had children.
Jacob saw Esau coming with four hundred men.
Jacob divided his family for safety.
Jacob put the maidservants and their children at the front.
Jacob put Leah and her children behind them.
Jacob put Rachel and Joseph at the very back.
passages.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת־ הַשְּׁפָח֛וֹת וְאֶת־ יַלְדֵיהֶ֖ן רִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה וְאֶת־ לֵאָ֤ה וִֽילָדֶ֙יהָ֙ אַחֲרֹנִ֔ים וְאֶת־ רָחֵ֥ל וְאֶת־ יוֹסֵ֖ף אַחֲרֹנִֽים׃

passages.text: But Jacob himself went on ahead and bowed to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the son of Isaac and the grandson of Abraham.
Jacob saw his brother Esau coming with four hundred men.
Jacob went ahead of his family and servants.
Jacob bowed down to the ground.
Jacob bowed seven times.
Jacob did this as he walked toward his brother Esau.
passages.original: וְה֖וּא עָבַ֣ר לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁתַּ֤חוּ אַ֙רְצָה֙ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֔ים עַד־ גִּשְׁתּ֖וֹ עַד־ אָחִֽיו׃

passages.text: Esau, however, ran to him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. And they both wept.
passages.sermon:
Esau was Jacob’s brother.
Esau saw Jacob coming.
Esau ran to meet Jacob.
Esau embraced Jacob.
Esau put his arms around Jacob’s neck.
Esau kissed Jacob.
Both Esau and Jacob wept.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨רָץ עֵשָׂ֤ו לִקְרָאתוֹ֙ וַֽיְחַבְּקֵ֔הוּ וַיִּפֹּ֥ל עַל־ צַוָּארָ֖ו וַׄיִּׄשָּׁׄקֵ֑ׄהׄוּׄ וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃

passages.text: When Esau looked up and saw the women and children, he asked, “Who are these with you?” Jacob answered, “These are the children God has graciously given your servant.”
passages.sermon:
Esau looked up.
Esau saw the women.
Esau saw the children.
Esau asked Jacob, "Who are these with you?"
Jacob answered Esau.
Jacob said, "These are the children."
Jacob said, "God has graciously given these children to your servant."
Jacob called himself Esau's servant.
passages.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א אֶת־ עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּ֤רְא אֶת־ הַנָּשִׁים֙ וְאֶת־ הַיְלָדִ֔ים וַיֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־ אֵ֣לֶּה לָּ֑ךְ וַיֹּאמַ֕ר הַיְלָדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁר־ חָנַ֥ן אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־ עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then the maidservants and their children approached and bowed down.
passages.sermon:
The maidservants came forward.
Their children came with them.
The maidservants bowed down.
Their children also bowed down.

passages.text: Leah and her children also approached and bowed down, and then Joseph and Rachel approached and bowed down.
passages.sermon:
Leah was Jacob’s wife.
Leah had children.
Leah and her children walked forward.
Leah and her children bowed down.
Joseph was Jacob’s son.
Rachel was Jacob’s wife.
Joseph and Rachel walked forward after Leah and her children.
Joseph and Rachel bowed down.
passages.original: וַתִּגַּ֧שׁ גַּם־ לֵאָ֛ה וִילָדֶ֖יהָ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֑וּ וְאַחַ֗ר נִגַּ֥שׁ יוֹסֵ֛ף וְרָחֵ֖ל וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוֽוּ׃

passages.text: “What do you mean by sending this whole company to meet me?” asked Esau. “To find favor in your sight, my lord,” Jacob answered.
passages.sermon:
Esau saw a large group of people and animals.
Esau asked Jacob about them.
Esau said, “Why did you send this whole group to meet me?”
Jacob answered Esau.
Jacob said, “I sent them to find favor in your eyes, my lord.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֥י לְךָ֛ כָּל־ הַמַּחֲנֶ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּגָ֑שְׁתִּי וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לִמְצֹא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: “I already have plenty, my brother,” Esau replied. “Keep what belongs to you.”
passages.sermon:
Esau spoke to Jacob.
Esau is Jacob’s brother.
Esau said, “I have plenty.”
Esau said, “My brother, keep what belongs to you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר עֵשָׂ֖ו יֶשׁ־ לִ֣י רָ֑ב אָחִ֕י יְהִ֥י לְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁר־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: But Jacob insisted, “No, please! If I have found favor in your sight, then receive this gift from my hand. For indeed, I have seen your face, and it is like seeing the face of God, since you have received me favorably.
passages.sermon:
Jacob spoke to Esau.
Jacob said, "Please do not refuse me.
If I have found favor in your eyes, accept my gift from my hand.
I have seen your face.
Seeing your face is like seeing the face of God.
You have received me kindly."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֗ב אַל־ נָא֙ אִם־ נָ֨א מָצָ֤אתִי חֵן֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִנְחָתִ֖י מִיָּדִ֑י כִּ֣י עַל־ כֵּ֞ן רָאִ֣יתִי פָנֶ֗יךָ כִּרְאֹ֛ת פְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַתִּרְצֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Please accept my gift that was brought to you, because God has been gracious to me and I have all I need.” So Jacob pressed him until he accepted.
passages.sermon:
Jacob spoke to Esau.
Jacob said, "Please accept my gift."
Jacob said, "I brought this gift to you."
Jacob said, "God has been gracious to me."
Jacob said, "I have everything I need."
Jacob urged Esau to accept the gift.
Esau accepted the gift.
passages.original: קַח־ נָ֤א אֶת־ בִּרְכָתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֻבָ֣את לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־ חַנַּ֥נִי אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְכִ֣י יֶשׁ־ לִי־ כֹ֑ל וַיִּפְצַר־ בּ֖וֹ וַיִּקָּֽח׃

passages.text: Then Esau said, “Let us be on our way, and I will go ahead of you.”
passages.sermon: Esau spoke to Jacob.\r\nEsau said, “Let us travel together.”\r\nEsau said, “I will go ahead of you.”

passages.text: But Jacob replied, “My lord knows that the children are frail, and I must care for sheep and cattle that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard for even a day, all the animals will die.
passages.sermon:
Jacob spoke to Esau.
Jacob said, “My lord, you know the children are weak.
I am responsible for the sheep and cattle.
The sheep and cattle are nursing their young.
If I drive them hard for even one day, all the animals will die.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אֲדֹנִ֤י יֹדֵ֙עַ֙ כִּֽי־ הַיְלָדִ֣ים רַכִּ֔ים וְהַצֹּ֥אן וְהַבָּקָ֖ר עָל֣וֹת עָלָ֑י וּדְפָקוּם֙ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וָמֵ֖תוּ כָּל־ הַצֹּֽאן׃

passages.text: Please let my lord go ahead of his servant. I will continue on slowly, at a comfortable pace for the livestock and children, until I come to my lord at Seir.”
passages.sermon:
Jacob spoke to Esau.
Jacob called Esau "my lord."
Jacob called himself "your servant."
Jacob said, "Please go ahead of me."
Jacob said, "I will travel slowly."
Jacob said, "I will move at a pace that is comfortable for the livestock."
Jacob said, "I will move at a pace that is comfortable for the children."
Jacob said, "I will do this until I come to you at Seir."
passages.original: יַעֲבָר־ נָ֥א אֲדֹנִ֖י לִפְנֵ֣י עַבְדּ֑וֹ וַאֲנִ֞י אֶֽתְנָהֲלָ֣ה לְאִטִּ֗י לְרֶ֨גֶל הַמְּלָאכָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־ לְפָנַי֙ וּלְרֶ֣גֶל הַיְלָדִ֔ים עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־ אָבֹ֥א אֶל־ אֲדֹנִ֖י שֵׂעִֽירָה׃

passages.text: “Let me leave some of my people with you,” Esau said. But Jacob replied, “Why do that? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”
passages.sermon:
Esau spoke to Jacob.
Esau offered to leave some of his people with Jacob.
Jacob answered Esau.
Jacob asked, "Why do that?"
Jacob said, "Let me find favor in your eyes, my lord."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַצִּֽיגָה־ נָּ֣א עִמְּךָ֔ מִן־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתִּ֑י וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לָ֣מָּה זֶּ֔ה אֶמְצָא־ חֵ֖ן בְּעֵינֵ֥י אֲדֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir, but Jacob went on to Succoth, where he built a house for himself and shelters for his livestock; that is why the place was called Succoth.
passages.sermon:
Esau was Jacob’s brother.
Esau returned to his home in Seir that day.
Jacob traveled to a place called Succoth.
Jacob built a house for himself at Succoth.
Jacob made shelters for his livestock at Succoth.
Because of these shelters, Jacob named the place Succoth.
passages.original: וַיָּשָׁב֩ בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֛ו לְדַרְכּ֖וֹ שֵׂעִֽירָה׃ וְיַעֲקֹב֙ נָסַ֣ע סֻכֹּ֔תָה וַיִּ֥בֶן ל֖וֹ בָּ֑יִת וּלְמִקְנֵ֙הוּ֙ עָשָׂ֣ה סֻכֹּ֔ת עַל־ כֵּ֛ן קָרָ֥א שֵׁם־ הַמָּק֖וֹם סֻכּֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: After Jacob had come from Paddan-aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan, and he camped just outside the city.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was a man chosen by God.
Jacob traveled from Paddan-aram.
Jacob arrived in the land of Canaan.
Jacob came to the city of Shechem.
Jacob arrived safely.
Jacob camped just outside the city.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹא֩ יַעֲקֹ֨ב שָׁלֵ֜ם עִ֣יר שְׁכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בְּבֹא֖וֹ מִפַּדַּ֣ן אֲרָ֑ם וַיִּ֖חַן אֶת־ פְּנֵ֥י הָעִֽיר׃

passages.text: And the plot of ground where he pitched his tent, he purchased from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of silver.
passages.sermon:
Jacob arrived at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan.
Jacob had come from Paddan-aram.
Jacob camped just outside the city.
Jacob pitched his tent on a plot of ground.
Jacob bought this plot of ground.
He bought it from the sons of Hamor.
Hamor was the father of Shechem.
Jacob paid one hundred pieces of silver for the land.
passages.original: וַיִּ֜קֶן אֶת־ חֶלְקַ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָֽטָה־ שָׁם֙ אָהֳל֔וֹ מִיַּ֥ד בְּנֵֽי־ חֲמ֖וֹר אֲבִ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם בְּמֵאָ֖ה קְשִׂיטָֽה׃

passages.text: There he set up an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the son of Isaac and Rebekah.
Jacob arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan.
Jacob set up an altar there.
Jacob called the altar El-Elohe-Israel.
El-Elohe-Israel means "God, the God of Israel."
passages.original: וַיַּצֶּב־ שָׁ֖ם מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וַיִּ֨קְרָא־ ל֔וֹ אֵ֖ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
